title: AffectWorld: Benchmarking Emotion-Driven Future World Prediction
title_zh: AffectWorld：基于情绪的未来世界预测基准测试

paragraphs.en: AffectWorld 是一个基于情绪的世界演化基准测试，旨在评估模型在情绪驱动行为和世界状态变化方面的表现。 The world encompasses both physical environments and human actors. Predicting its evolution requires understanding both physical laws and how emotions shape human actions. However, existing world model benchmarks primarily assess physical plausibility and perceptual quality, leaving emotion-driven world evolution largely untested.We introduce AffectWorld, a benchmark that evaluates the chain Emotion-Action-World State through three tasks: World-State Consistency, Emotion-Action Consistency, and Causal Consistency. It comprises 1,498 everyday video samples annotated with plausible emotions, action tendencies, and atomic world-state constraints. A counterfactual subset of 233 samples tests whether changing an agent's emotion under fixed scene and event conditions yields corresponding changes in actions and consequences. We define eight metrics across the three tasks and an additional counterfactual metric, combining automatic visual assessment with human-calibrated VLM/LLM judgments. Evaluations of five SoTA world models (e.g., Cosmos3) required world-state change scores of 0.100-0.280 and counterfactual emotion sensitivity scores of 0.027-0.070 on a [0, 1] scale. These results reveal substantial gaps in generating the consequences of emotion-driven actions and adapting future predictions to emotional interventions. AffectWorld provides a testbed for advancing world models that capture how emotions shape future physical and social states.
paragraphs.zh: AffectWorld 是一个基于情绪的世界演化基准测试，旨在评估模型在情绪驱动行为和世界状态变化方面的表现。世界既包含物理环境，也包含人类参与者。 预测其演化需要同时理解物理定律以及情绪如何塑造人类行为。 然而，现有的世界模型基准主要评估物理合理性和感知质量，而情绪驱动的世界演化则基本未被测试。我们提出了 AffectWorld，一个通过三项任务评估“情绪-行动-世界状态”链条的基准：世界状态一致性、情绪-行动一致性和因果一致性。 该基准包含 1,498 个日常视频样本，并标注了合理的情绪、行动倾向和原子化的世界状态约束。 一个由 233 个样本组成的反事实子集用于测试：在固定场景和事件条件下，改变智能体的情绪是否会导致行动和结果的相应变化。 我们在三项任务中定义了八项指标，并增加了一项反事实指标，将自动视觉评估与经人类校准的 VLM/LLM 判断相结合。 对五个 SoTA 世界模型（例如 Cosmos3）的评估显示，其世界状态变化分数在 [0, 1] 尺度上为 0.100-0.280，反事实情绪敏感度分数为 0.027-0.070。 这些结果揭示了在生成情绪驱动行动的后果以及根据情绪干预调整未来预测方面存在显著差距。 AffectWorld 提供了一个测试平台，用于推动能够捕捉情绪如何塑造未来物理和社会状态的世界模型发展。
